# [TASK] Professional Kibana dashboard suite (Lens, multi-dashboard, alerting)

## Task
Rebuild the local ELK stack's Kibana experience into a real, multi-dashboard observability suite, built with the Lens editor — not just the one legacy Visualize-editor dashboard (`lmdb-overview.ndjson`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] 3 Kibana Lens dashboards: Service Health, Error Triage, Per-Service Deep-Dive (`grep -cE '"id":"lmdb-(service-health|error-triage|per-service-deep-dive)"' infrastructure/docker/elk/kibana/lmdb-lens-suite.ndjson` → 3)
- [x] Interactive Controls dropdown filtering by `application` on all 3 dashboards (manual: confirmed live against Kibana 8.15.3 — each dashboard's `controlGroupInput` filters on the `application` field)
- [x] `lmdb-logs-*` data view has field formatting on `level` (red ERROR, orange WARN) (`grep -o '#E7664C\|#F5A700' infrastructure/docker/elk/kibana/lmdb-lens-suite.ndjson | wc -l` → 2)
- [x] 2 alerting rules (error-rate threshold per service; elevated WARN/ERROR volume) using the built-in `.server-log` connector, no external credentials (`grep -c '"alertTypeId":".es-query"' infrastructure/docker/elk/kibana/lmdb-alerting.ndjson` → 2; `grep -c '"actionTypeId":".server-log"' infrastructure/docker/elk/kibana/lmdb-alerting.ndjson` → 3)
- [x] All saved objects checked into `infrastructure/docker/elk/kibana/*.ndjson`, imported by `setup.sh` on every `docker-compose up` (`grep -c "ndjson;type=application/ndjson" infrastructure/docker/elk/setup/setup.sh` → 4)

## Not in scope
- APM / request-latency dashboards — no distributed tracing yet (#42)
- ML anomaly detection — Elasticsearch Basic license locally, no ML
- A Kibana homepage linking the 3 dashboards — that's #112

## Estimate
**Hours:** not estimated (closed before hour estimates were required)

## Notes
Built by scripting Kibana's REST API, then verified live: all 3 dashboards, the Controls dropdown, and both alerting rules were checked against a running Kibana with one rule observed firing end-to-end. Kibana needed `xpack.encryptedSavedObjects.encryptionKey` set for alerting/connectors to work at all (500s otherwise); added to `docker-compose.elk.yml` and `.env.example` as `KIBANA_ENCRYPTION_KEY`.

Prior sessions in the autonomous sandbox (no Docker daemon there) correctly left this blocked; done in a Docker-capable session instead.

The `filmpire-*` saved-object names in this issue's original text are stale — #151 renamed the project to LMDB, and the files, IDs, and index names here are all `lmdb-*` today.
